en.sayed-ali-raza: You should fear Allāh about yourself
and not allow Satan to lead you.
Turn your face towards the next world
because that is our path and your path,
and fear that Allāh may not entangle you in any sudden infliction which may destroy the root as well as cut away the branches.
I swear to you by Allāh an oath which will not be broken
that if destiny brings me and you together
I shall steadfastly hold before you: Until Allāh judges between us, and He is the Best of the judges. (Qur’ān, 7:87)
